title: Standalone TABLECONTENT TABLESTYLE reference output

scope.operation: Write the standalone TABLECONTENT group-340 TABLESTYLE reference through the rooted adapter object plan.
scope.profile: Generated AC1027 scalar-grid TABLECONTENT referring to one locally authored, NOD-rooted TABLESTYLE; ASCII and binary input/output cross-product.
scope.source_basis: The parser retains the TABLECONTENT group-340 handle, but dxfRW::writeTableContent rejected every nonzero table-style handle and emitted literal zero. The adapter's table-style planner collected legacy TABLE references only, so standalone TABLECONTENT did not request rooted style closure.
limits: One nonzero TABLESTYLE handle from the ACAD_TABLESTYLE NOD dictionary
Existing bounded scalar-grid content profile; no nonzero column, row or cell base-style IDs
AC1027 DXF input and output only
No CELLSTYLEMAP custom-style IDs or native rendering qualification
scope.claim_boundary: Selected AC1027 DXF reference transport and rooted output closure only; no DWG output, custom CELLSTYLEMAP IDs, native TABLE rendering, or general TABLESTYLE field qualification.

implementation: Add standalone TABLECONTENT group-340 style references to prepareTableFallbackGraph's requested-style set so the rooted ACAD_TABLESTYLE dictionary validates and emits the referenced record.

Allow dxfRW::writeTableContent to accept only nonzero style handles registered by that adapter plan, remap the source handle, and emit the remapped group-340 value in both 1x1 and rectangular-grid serializers.
Preserve zero as the absent-style value; DRW::NoHandle is also zero and must not reject the default profile.

evidence.physical_wire: For all four input/output encoding pairs, an independent walker joins TABLECONTENT group 340 to the emitted TABLESTYLE group-5 identity.
evidence.typed_readback: Fresh imports preserve the TABLECONTENT reference and resolve it to the emitted TABLESTYLE record.
evidence.failure_control: A group-340 source handle changed to unrooted 0xDEAD is refused before publication; the existing destination sentinel and explicit caller handle remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring the rooted source handle permits same-adapter retry; fresh typed readback confirms the TABLECONTENT-to-TABLESTYLE join.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.
Standalone TABLECONTENT nonzero standard/custom base-style IDs and CELLSTYLEMAP closure remain open; the current next packet is the selected standard-ID path.
Other TABLEFORMAT properties, native rendering and DWG output are not claimed.
